dedupe_keys.name: nova data center generator permit atlas the emissions reporting gap

description: Keystone GIS publishes a Northern Virginia data-centre atlas linking campus locations with backup-generator air permits and emissions records. Zenodo provides an archive, a source manifest and a verification report under CC BY 4.0. The team reconciles OpenStreetMap site and building features, EPA ECHO permitted facilities and the 2023 National Emissions Inventory into 106 campus units. The files document permit classifications, enforcement history and jurisdiction totals. These data can support outage-backup, emissions and siting simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this reconciled atlas. Coverage is nine Northern Virginia jurisdictions and the source vintages, not every operating generator or measured emergency run hour. A limitation is that spatial matching uses an 800-metre adjacency rule and source records disagree; the verification report records corrected ECHO flag encoding and separate site extents from building footprints. The archive was not downloaded or independently re-matched.
